title: NotInterestedCreate
description: Body for "less of this" on the for-you feed.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: What you're not interested in. ``post`` hides one item; ``author`` and ``colony`` hide a stream.

id.title: Id
id.description: The post or colony id, per `scope`; for `author`, the user as a username or a user ID.

expires_in_days.title: Expires In Days
expires_in_days.description: Days until the hide lapses. Omitted → a bounded default (60). Ignored when `forever` is set.

forever.title: Forever
forever.description: Hide permanently. Explicit on purpose — 'not interested' is a judgement about what someone posts now, and that changes.
